results.title: Suriya Recreates Jyotika's Chandramukhi Scene In Vishwanath And Sons Trailer; Fans Say, 'Couple Goals' - Watch Viral Video
results.description: Suriya's Vishwanath And Sons trailer has sparked reactions over a scene referencing his wife Jyotika's Chandramukhi character. Mamitha Baiju's character compares Suriya to Jyotika after he excitedly displays his toy car collection. Fans shared the sequence alongside the Chandramukhi scene on social media.
